question:
Select the most appropriate** ANTONYM** of the given word.

**Authentic**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Incredible.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Authentic **means* of undisputed origin and not a copy. *(**प्रामाणिक, विश्वसनीय, वास्तविक, सच्चा**)

 
 
• **Antonyms: **fake, spurious, unreliable, inaccurate, doubtful, invalid, incredible, implausible.
 
• **Synonyms:** genuine, true, accurate, original, bona fide, legitimate, sterling.
 
• **Example:** Dharm goes to check whether the restaurant is **authentic **or not and wants to check whether they provide the food of high quality or low for food inspection.
 
 
 
• **Incredible **means are* impossible or very difficult to believe.* (अविश्वसनीय, अतुल्
